---
title: "Matt Ridley’s The Rational Optimist…"
date: "2010-09-17"
categories: ["Economics"]
---

...is currently available for free on (US) [Kindle](http://www.amazon.com/gp/product/B003QP4BJM?ie=UTF8&tag=institutional-20&linkCode=xm2&camp=1789&creativeASIN=B003QP4BJM "Kindle"). I disagree with at least one aspect of Ridley’s work, which I may blog about at a later date, but there is plenty in the book to like.

Ridley incorrectly identifies my CIS colleague Peter Saunders as an ‘Australian economist’ when he is in fact a British sociologist (although Saunders probably understands economics better than the average Australian economist).
